# How to Generate Mock Usage

Generating mock usage is important during the development process to have test data to work with.

## Table of Contents

- [Details](#details)
  - [Generating mock usage](#generating-mock-usage)
  - [Generate historical mock usage](#generate-historical-mock-usage)

## Details

### Generating mock usage

In dev, usage can be generated by running `./script/produce` (assuming `./script/server` is already running).

### Generate historical mock usage

Options for creating usage in the past for testing:

- `script/produce --days_span=10`
  - creates usage data spanning over the past 10 days occurring every hour.
- `script/produce --days_span=10 --hours_interval=12`
  - creates usage data spanning over the past 10 days every 12 hours.
- `script/produce --timeTravel --timeTravelDate=2022-01-01T00:00:00Z`
  - creates only usage at exactly 12 am Jan 1, 2022
- `script/produce --days_span=10 --timeTravel --timeTravelDate=2022-01-10T00:00:00Z`
  - creates usage every hour spanning over 10 days from Jan 1, 2022 to Jan 10, 2022
- `script/produce --days_span=10 --hours_interval=12 --timeTravel --timeTravelDate=2022-01-10T00:00:00Z`
  - creates usage every 12 hours spanning over 10 days from Jan 1, 2022 to Jan 10, 2022
